_about: Invented for the Familiar demo. What the host told at the start, one statement per item, before any research.

items.text: Grandfather Amaro came from the islands and crossed the ocean as a young man.
items.witness: heard from his mother Helena many times

items.text: Amaro worked about forty years in the cotton mill in Quarry Bend.
items.witness: saw him walk to the mill as a child
his mother said so; no paper seen

items.text: Amaro died in Quarry Bend in 1968.
Grandmother Rosa kept a garden of kale behind the house and could not read.
Rosa came over to marry Amaro, from somewhere near his village.
items.witness: his mother said so; Rosa never spoke of it to him

items.text: Rosa died in Quarry Bend in 1981.
Helena was born in Quarry Bend.
items.witness: his mother's own word; the certificate agrees

items.text: There is a baptism certificate of Helena in a biscuit tin.
